notes.title: Updated Controller Binds
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added Shoot action to left trigger, right trigger, and right face button
[*]Added Jump action to top face button
[/list]

Some people have reported that controllers are not working at all. I am looking into this issue, but in the meantime try enabling or disabling Steam Input in the Steam Overlay.
